title: Poached Duck Breast with Orange Glaze
description: A simple yet elegant dish featuring poached duck breast with a sweet and tangy orange glaze.
instructions: Rinse the duck breast under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat the water in a large saucepan over medium heat until it reaches 160°F.
Add the shallots, garlic, and rosemary to the water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the duck breast to the water and poach for 15-20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Remove the duck from the water and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the orange marmalade, orange juice, and honey in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring the glaze to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
Slice the duck breast and serve with the orange glaze spooned over the top.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
